items.example: I need some time to mull it over.

items.simple: To think about something slowly and carefully for a long time.

items.example: You can opt out of the emails at any time.
items.simple: To choose not to be part of something.

items.example: They're phasing out the old model.

items.exampleTr: Herkes kabul etsin diye planı sulandırdılar.
